caseNameFull: Query, constituting the South Carolina Tax Commission v. United States
attorneys: Messrs. John M. Daniel and Claude K. Wingate for petitioners. Solicitor General Fahy for respondents.

opinions.text: The order denying certiorari, 314 U. S. 685, is vacated. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit is granted.
